title: Fence (fences/items/<id>/fence.json)
description: A kind of fence the house view draws along the sides of a property: a wire mesh, a wooden palisade, a wall, a hedge. One side of a fence is one kind; the user chooses its height and may change its colour.

draft.description: Colour of the side on the overlay of the editor: bright, and unlike the one of every other kind, since it is how the kinds of a fence are told apart while it is edited.

height.description: Height of the fence in metres: the one it is given when chosen, and the bounds offered.

thickness.description: Thickness in metres: 0 for a sheet (wire mesh, welded panel), a few centimetres for boards, more for a wall or a hedge.

surface.description: What the fence is made of: at least its colour, and the texture of a solid one (boards, render, stones, leaves). A row of its units is a course, as on a wall: the height of a unit comes first in `cell`, then its length along the fence.

open.description: A see-through fence: wires or bars of the colour of the surface, drawn on nothing. Without it the fence is solid.

pattern.description: mesh: wire netting in diamonds. grid: welded wires in upright rectangles (rigid panel). bars: upright bars between two rails (wrought iron, pickets).

pitch.description: Distance between two wires or two bars, in metres.

fill.description: Share of the sheet the wires or the bars cover, which is also how solid the fence looks from afar: 0.1 a thin wire, 0.6 wide pickets.

posts.description: Posts standing along the fence. Without them the fence holds by itself (a wall, a hedge).

spacing.description: Distance between two posts, in metres.

size.description: Side of a post, in metres.

foliage.description: A hedge: its top and its faces are uneven, as clipped foliage is.

coping.description: A wall a coping can be laid on: the user caps its sides with an entry of the `copings` section, or leaves them bare. Only a solid fence at least 0.1 m thick, never a hedge.
